record.field: Basic category to compute the net salary: the paid time types and every amount paid to or withheld from the employee.

Salary income paid in the period, in cash or in kind (Tax Code, art. 101), before the employee pension contribution and the privileges: column 7 of the declaration of tax withheld at source, and base of the funded pension contributions (Law on Funded Pensions, art. 2 and 3(6)). The per diem and the travel costs within the norms, the refund of the expenses incurred for the employer and the State benefits are left out.
Regular allowances of the contract added to the wage: with the wage, they give the month of remuneration of the severance and of the annual leave.
